---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

### Set-up

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)

download.file("https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/2292172", "data/surveys.csv", quiet = TRUE)
download.file("https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/3299474", "data/plots.csv", quiet = TRUE)
download.file("https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/3299483", "data/species.csv", quiet = TRUE)
download.file("https://esapubs.org/archive/ecol/E095/178/MamFuncDat.txt", "data/MamFuncDat.txt", quiet = TRUE)
```

### 1. Import the Data

```{r}
print("1: dimensions (rows, columns) of each data frame")
surveys       <- read_csv("data/surveys.csv")
plots         <- read_csv("data/plots.csv")
species       <- read_csv("data/species.csv")
mammal_traits <- read_tsv("data/MamFuncDat.txt")

dim(surveys)
dim(plots)
dim(species)
dim(mammal_traits)
```

### 2. Tidy the Trait Table

```{r}
print("2")
traits <- mammal_traits |>
  rename(sci_name = Scientific,
         mass_g = `BodyMass-Value`) |>
  select(sci_name, mass_g, `Diet-Inv`:`Diet-PlantO`)
traits
dim(traits)
```

### 3. Match Portal Species to Traits

```{r}
print("3a")
rodent_species <- species |>
  filter(taxa == "Rodent") |>
  unite("sci_name", genus, species, sep = " ", remove = FALSE)
rodent_species

print("3b: rodent species with no match in the trait table")
rodent_species |>
  left_join(traits, join_by(sci_name)) |>
  filter(is.na(mass_g)) |>
  select(species_id, sci_name, genus, species, mass_g)

print("3c: 24 species")
rodent_traits <- species |>
  filter(taxa == "Rodent") |>
  mutate(species = replace(species, species == "harrisi", "harrisii"),
         genus = replace(genus, species_id == "PH", "Chaetodipus")) |>
  unite("sci_name", genus, species, sep = " ", remove = FALSE) |>
  inner_join(traits, join_by(sci_name))
rodent_traits
nrow(rodent_traits)
```

### 4. Build the Analysis Table

```{r}
print("4")
portal <- surveys |>
  inner_join(rodent_traits, join_by(species_id)) |>
  inner_join(plots, join_by(plot_id)) |>
  filter(plot_type == "Control" | plot_type == "Long-term Krat Exclosure")
portal

print("4: captures per plot type")
portal |>
  group_by(plot_type) |>
  summarize(n_captures = n())
```

### 5. Relative Abundance of Kangaroo Rats

```{r}
print("5a")
species_abund <- portal |>
  group_by(plot_type, genus, species) |>
  summarize(n = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(plot_type) |>
  mutate(rel_abund = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(plot_type, desc(rel_abund))
species_abund

print("5a: relative abundances sum to 1 within each plot type")
species_abund |>
  group_by(plot_type) |>
  summarize(total = sum(rel_abund))

print("5b")
species_abund |>
  filter(genus == "Dipodomys") |>
  group_by(plot_type) |>
  summarize(prop_krats = sum(rel_abund))
```

### 6. Body Size Through Time

```{r}
print("6a")
size_by_year <- portal |>
  group_by(year, plot_type) |>
  summarize(n_captures = n(),
            mean_mass_g = mean(mass_g)) |>
  ungroup()
size_by_year

print("6b")
size_plot <- ggplot(size_by_year, aes(x = year, y = mean_mass_g)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  facet_wrap(~ plot_type) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Community mean body mass (g)") +
  theme_bw()
size_plot

# 6c
dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("plots/body_size_through_time.png", size_plot, width = 8, height = 4)
```

### 7. Community Diet

```{r}
print("7a")
diet_long <- portal |>
  pivot_longer(`Diet-Inv`:`Diet-PlantO`,
               names_to = "diet",
               values_to = "diet_percent") |>
  extract(diet, into = "diet", regex = "Diet-(.*)")
diet_long |>
  select(record_id, sci_name, plot_type, diet, diet_percent)

print("7b")
community_diet <- diet_long |>
  group_by(plot_type, diet) |>
  summarize(mean_percent = mean(diet_percent)) |>
  ungroup()
community_diet

print("7b: each plot type sums to 100")
community_diet |>
  group_by(plot_type) |>
  summarize(total = sum(mean_percent))

print("7c")
community_diet <- community_diet |>
  mutate(mean_percent = na_if(mean_percent, 0)) |>
  drop_na(mean_percent)
community_diet

print("7d")
diet_compare <- community_diet |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = plot_type, values_from = mean_percent) |>
  rename(control = Control,
         exclosure = `Long-term Krat Exclosure`) |>
  mutate(difference = exclosure - control) |>
  arrange(desc(difference))
diet_compare

print("7e")
diet_plot <- ggplot(community_diet, aes(x = diet, y = mean_percent, color = plot_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Diet category",
       y = "Mean percent of diet",
       color = "Plot type") +
  theme_bw()
diet_plot

ggsave("plots/community_diet.png", diet_plot, width = 6, height = 4)
```

### Extension: Do the Database Masses Match What Portal Measured?

```{r}
print("Extension a-b")
mass_check <- portal |>
  group_by(sci_name, mass_g) |>
  summarize(n_captures = n(),
            mean_weight_g = mean(weight, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(mean_weight_g))
mass_check

print("Extension c")
ggplot(mass_check, aes(x = mass_g, y = mean_weight_g)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Database body mass (g)",
       y = "Mean measured weight at Portal (g)") +
  theme_bw()

print("Extension d")
mass_check |>
  mutate(ratio = mass_g / mean_weight_g) |>
  arrange(desc(ratio)) |>
  select(sci_name, n_captures, mass_g, mean_weight_g, ratio)
```
